title: Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Etiquette of Eating. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you do before eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on Etiquette of Eating helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING
Study Hadith on Etiquette of Eating like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating

What this means
In this part you learn to read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on Etiquette of Eating” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Etiquette of Eating in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.). You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on Etiquette of Eating is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on Etiquette of Eating” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Etiquette of Eating in your own words. (skill: demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.))

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.))

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating.
3. Practise this skill: demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Etiquette of Eating: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Hadith on Etiquette of Eating?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do before eating?
2. What is the benefit of saying Bismillah while eating?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on Etiquette of Eating means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating.
5. Be able to: demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
